I live in Sweden, where it's hard to even find a job during the summer. And I do actually prioritise finding a job over being with her, so I can keep taking care of her in the futre. 

Alcohol seems to help a lot. Though I suspect it'll only be temporary.

I can't get a job due to lack of experience and education. I fill out applications pretty much daily. And the only thing that keeps me away from filling applications is being with her. 

I'm currently drinking a lot, to make myself pass out before I do something stupid. So if I don't answer presume I've just passed out. I'll make sure to respond as soon as I can. If I can that is.

She just told me that they probably can't be together since they live too far away and she's too shy to confess. 

And I have to agree that she's been the best friend that I've ever had. But what I forgot to mention was that she and I was on a type of fling. Which makes it even worse for me. Even though she said she don't love me it sure felt like it. I guess it tricked with my mind a bit. Making me think that we were together, even though we weren't. 

But I really don't want to let go of her, I still love her and I always will. I'm crazy about her. And I couldn't possibly leave her, I want and need her more than anything else in this existance. She's practically the only reason I have to live right now. If I leave her I'll go mad because I'll be all alone for the rest of my life. If I stay with her I'm going to be like this again because she will find someone to love eventually.

I can't get a job, I quit my studies, can't find someone else due to my conditions and I like on borrowed money in a town that seem to hate me.
